0x86863ec6.notice: Runs the access-control + emergency-stop + Safe-cut module initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

params.admin: The address granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` (manages guardians and resumes operation).
params.minThreshold: The minimum signature threshold the pinned Safe must enforce.
params.safe: The Gnosis Safe multisig pinned as the sole cut authority.

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for a Safe-gated diamond-cut diamond — seeds AccessControl (so guardian management + `emergencyResume` are `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`-gated), EmergencyStop, registers the IDiamondCut + IDiamondLoupe ERC-165 flags, and pins the Safe authority + minimum threshold. Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open). Mirrors exactly what the old `MockSafeDiamond.initialize` did, minus the redundant pre/postInitializer. Companion to the {ERC2981Init} pattern — a first-class production deploy artifact.
